answer: Sybil defence by identity bonding through slashed collateral: every new agent must lock a stake in a shared escrow grove before it can transact, and each attestation is minted into a jade-marked reputation record co-signed only by independent peers. Cloning an identity therefore means cloning its capital and its reviewers, so a fake fleet must fund and warm up every puppet separately while detected duplicate behaviour burns the bond. For an attacker, that haven of free multipliers vanishes: each forged agent now carries real, at-risk cost.
